rules.statement: Default proceedings under the Civil Procedure Code do not apply to partition actions.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. Section 48 (4) does not help the 4th defendant petitioner as he had sent out his claim through a lawyer. 2. Default proceedings spelt out in the Civil Procedure Code do not apply to partition actions. 3. The trial on 24.01.83 has been held inter-partes
